description: Remove a tag from a task without deleting the tag from the Space. Returns a confirmation. Use to untag a single task.

custom_task_ids.description: Set true when `task_id` is a custom task ID instead of a native ClickUp ID. Requires `team_id`.

tag_name.description: Name of the tag to remove from the task.

task_id.description: ID of the task to untag.

team_id.description: Team/Workspace ID. Falls back to CLICKUP_TEAM_ID when omitted.

name: remove_tag_from_task
